classification.difficultyReason: Recognise semicircles and quadrants, undo the corresponding area fraction, divide by pi, and take the positive square root. Formula scaffolds and the taught procedure make the sequence direct.

content.prompt: Calculate the radius of each semicircle or quadrant, rounding your answer to 2 d.p.

spec.sourceRegion: Question 2a, figure to the right of the area and supplied formula
spec.description: Unfilled downward-facing semicircle with its horizontal diameter at the top. A dimension arrow above the right half of the diameter is labelled r.
spec.mathematics: The radius dimension extends from the diameter midpoint to its right endpoint.
spec.answerVisibility: The radius label is a permanent given; no numerical answer is drawn.

spec.mathematics: Two perpendicular radii bound a quarter-circle. The right-angle square follows their horizontal and vertical directions.
spec.answerVisibility: The radius label and right-angle mark are permanent givens; no numerical answer is drawn.
